thread:
maria: Support reported a customer saw 500 when they hit a tenant quota on /v1/generate. They expected 429.
kevin: Can you paste the raw response?
maria: ```http
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
X-Route-Id: r-17
X-Quota-Check: deferred
{ \"error\": \"shard_down\" }
```
tara: Why are late quota checks leaking 5xx? We only translate to 429 at ingress.
govind: Because in dedicated pools we sometimes perform quota admission at the route. If route fails after forward, gateway just proxies the 5xx.
kevin: Proposal: introduce a lightweight "client_status" tag in the final decision path (quota|infra|unknown). Gateway will map client_status=quota -> 429 and add stable headers: `X-Client-Status: quota_exceeded`, `X-Quota-Origin: route|ingress`, `X-Quota-Subcode: tenant_limit`. infra errors remain 5xx but include `X-Client-Status: infra_error`.
tara: For streaming, we can't change status mid-stream. Emit a terminal event `\{"type\":\"terminal\",\"client_status\":\"quota_exceeded\",\"code\":429}` as the last chunk and close stream. Document SDK handling.
govind: Telemetry: add `client_visible_status` metric with labels `client_status`, `quota_origin`, `route_id`. Dashboards should show percent of 5xx that are actually quota.
maria: Console: add a route banner: "This route is limited by tenant quota. Request higher limits on the Quotas page." Link to per-route quota history. Keep copy short.
kevin: Rollout: feature-flag `normalize_client_status` on gateway. Canary 10% for 24h. Monitor 429 increase (expected), any regression in 5xx infra, and SDK misclassifications. Pager if stream truncations > 1%.
ci-bot: ci: build passed for feat/normalize-client-status.
kevin: I'll open the gateway PR. @govind will add telemetry tags/dashboard, @tara updates SDK docs + streaming docs, @maria drafts the customer note.
maria: Thanks — I'll handle the support follow-up and post a short changelog snippet about the new headers.
